name: Scripps parallel pressure reactor, Freeslate Jr + OSR module (NIH S10 OD025208, 2018)
brief: A shared catalysis and medicinal-chemistry instrument: a robotic platform that runs eight parallel reactions with independent temperature and pressure control under air, hydrogen, CO, CO2 or SO2, and can take reaction aliquots during a run without depressurising, for fast reaction optimisation and kinetics studies.

cost.excludes_note: Grant award amount, not an invoice; may not include installation, service contract or cost share.

notes: No workflow: the Freeslate Jr. is not in the catalog (Big Kahuna is a different product).
